prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1084; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: Vehicle was inspected at the shop following a collision while making a left turn. The front driver-side bumper cover is cracked and the headlamp assembly is broken, with the fender showing crush damage that lines up with the reported point of impact. A few older scratches along the rear quarter panel may predate this loss and have been noted separately. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the fender, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested are consistent with the extent of damage seen. Parts and labor charges on the submitted invoices show no repeated entries.
